realizes.rationale: This collector compares base link targets with the candidate and emits the unresolved target-key obligation.

1.note: Raises link_target work for a surviving authored record link whose retrieval target this leaf removed. Range-content changes alone raise no item: links are retrieval pointers, not realization-currentness claims. Remove or restate the target key in K_C; a no-impact history row cannot answer it. Reconsideration links belong to their separate trigger owner.
